implementation: src/index.mjs; pure producer and executable in-memory publication contract, no durable runtime or renderer

ProjectionSource.revision: opaque exact owner snapshot token; never read latest; owner must provide an accessible exact snapshot

DataProjection.meaning: already adopted owner references only; no name/path/shape interpretation or value conflict resolution

SceneProjection.lineage: exact source tuple + producer/request + DataProjection key/revision + exact Scene configuration
SceneProjection.authority: available action is not authorized; final command admission stays with its owner

ProjectedInteraction.input: owner-declared @zixcel/interaction InputDeclaration, unchanged; operation and contract references must equal the action binding
ProjectedInteraction.authority: descriptor only, never submitted values, source bindings or authorization; missing declaration means read-only/unavailable

ProjectionRevision: pp: + SHA-256 of bounded canonical JSON contract/kind/key/exact lineage/data; minted by Projection Platform, never copied from source, Graph commit or delivery sequence
serialization: plain JSON; keys lexically sorted, unordered sources/items/relations normalized, ordered Scene regions retained; finite safe integers, well-formed Unicode; no getters/toJSON/functions/prototypes; digest is content identity, not authenticity

stateLayers.PresentationState: client scene selection, focus, selected item, expansion and navigation stack; separate from server ProjectionState

grouping: semantic group requires an exact owner semanticRef; structural source paths and presentation hints can group without becoming meaning; identical predicates group without merging or overwriting claim values
visibility: input is owner-policy-filtered and carries visibilityRef; visible/redacted/omitted are owner decisions, not PP authorization. Redacted item value and semantic/evidence/provenance refs are removed. Owner must omit relations that would disclose hidden data. Source refs themselves must be safe to disclose.
oversize: typed ProjectionLimitExceeded, no silent truncation. Upstream truncated flag preserved. Large metadata+BULK payload is deferred to PP runtime; 512 KiB STATE limit unchanged.
rebuild: readExact(ProjectionSource) must return exactly that snapshot; missing/reclaimed source yields ProjectionRebuildUnavailable, never latest substitution. Rebuild only from source owners, never previous cache.
retention: rebuild guaranteed only while every exact source tuple member remains available under owner retention/in-flight claims. This pure slice adds no lease or retention policy. C4 Retained/InFlight external roots can protect owner objects; later runtime must acquire/release those through source owners before promising a retention window.

PendingProjectionRepair.rule: exact source refs and original publication fence, no source body/cache as authority; source commit is not rolled back on projection failure

publication: one explicitly constructed in-memory slot per key, opaque CAS fence distinct from ProjectionRevision. Duplicate last accepted ticket is idempotent; older repair loses CAS after newer publication. Cache loss does not reset the fence. Durable CAS/scheduling/recovery stays PP1, no substitute Graph database here.
Crowsi: recovery returns Snapshot bytes or exact NoChange with opaque ProjectionRevision; producer has no transport dependency. Peer ACK is bytes received, not semantic adoption/rendered/user saw it.

ProjectionDelta.status: reserved contract only; not produced or accepted by this implementation
ProjectionDelta.operations: bounded owner-defined operations under exact producer contract; receiver validates exact base, target and lineage; never a Crowsi diff

SSR: serialize key/revision/exact lineage; adoptSnapshot checks the exact expected key/revision and closed payload/digest. No silent binding to latest. Source revision advancement requires an explicit owner recovery response.
